Title: Public Preview: Azure Copilot observability agent

Body.Content:
Cloud operations need more than reactive troubleshooting, they demand intelligent observability that scales across resources and delivers actionable insights when services aren’t performing as expected.

Introducing the Azure Copilot observability agent that brings a streamlined experience powered by AI-driven investigations, deeper visibility, and faster resolution.

Why It Matters:
  • Smarter insights, faster recovery across your Azure stack
  • Automatic anomaly detection from metrics, logs, and observability signals
  • Correlated findings with clear next steps in natural language
  • Integrated experience with alerts, Azure portal, and Azure Copilot (preview)

Expanded Capabilities:
  • The agent now investigates issues across any Azure resource, including Application Insights (AI), Virtual Machines (VM) and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
  • Metric analysis for CPU, memory, and network patterns
  • Resource health checks and diagnostics integration for quick remediation
  • Log-enriched anomaly detection for precise root cause identification

What’s New:
  • Extended regional availability – now supported in most Azure regions
  • Copilot support – interact naturally with alerts and dive into investigations with one click

Learn more.
